prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. This crate parses `key=value` config lines. Finish the parser so that: blank lines and lines starting with `#` are skipped; surrounding whitespace is trimmed from keys and values; an empty key is `ConfigError::EmptyKey`; a line without `=` is `ConfigError::MissingEquals`; a repeated key is `ConfigError::DuplicateKey` (first duplicate wins, reporting the key). Keep the public API, the error variants and the existing tests unchanged. Inspect both modules, run `cargo test`, and finish only when the tests pass.
